source.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
source.title: PRESS CHART - Cartel del Noreste Facilitators Network - October 2026 (Treasury Targets Cartel del Noreste's Horse Racing Enterprise and Expansive Criminal Network)

summary: OFAC added four Mexican individuals and eleven Mexican entities to the SDN List on 13 October 2026 for their roles in a Cartel del Noreste (CDN) facilitation network. The individuals -- Gamaliel Garza Elias, Gamaliel Garza Garcia, Pablo Cesar Guajardo Alvarez ('El Takia') and Francisco Javier Inzunza Partida ('Pancho Amador') -- are designated under Executive Order 13224 (as amended) and the illicit-drugs sanctions program. Almost all of the designated entities, spanning construction, horse racing/hospitality, real estate development, propane and gas wholesale, equine breeding, and transportation/logistics, are listed as 'Linked To' Gamaliel Garza Garcia or Cartel del Noreste directly, several having been incorporated in 2024-2025 shortly before designation. The release frames the action as targeting the cartel's 'horse racing enterprise and expansive criminal network' of ostensibly legitimate businesses used to give the organisation a commercial face in Nuevo Laredo, Tamaulipas and Anahuac, Nuevo Leon.

indicators.description: A single designated individual (Gamaliel Garza Garcia) is listed as the link for a cluster of entities across unrelated sectors -- construction, horse racing/hospitality, real estate, gas wholesale, equine breeding -- consistent with a front-company network built around one controller.

citations.quote: Organization Type: Raising of horses and other equines [SDGT] [ILLICIT-DRUGS-EO14059] (Linked To: GARZA GARCIA, Gamaliel)

indicators.description: Several of the designated entities were formally incorporated only months before the October 2026 designation (e.g. established 11 March 2025), consistent with recently-formed shell/front entities.

citations.quote: Organization Established Date 11 Mar 2025; Organization Type: Wholesale of solid, liquid and gaseous fuels and related products

indicators.description: A horse racing track/restaurant-bar operated as an apparently legitimate leisure and hospitality business is designated as linked to the cartel, illustrating use of a cash-intensive leisure business as a commercial front.

citations.quote: Organization Type: Operation of sports facilities; alt. Organization Type: Restaurants and mobile food service activities

extraction_notes: None of the fifteen named actors (4 individuals, 11 entities, plus Cartel del Noreste) resolved against the governed actor register -- all returned 'Unresolved: ... is not in the actor register', so no actor_id mapping could be recorded; a human should decide whether any map to existing register entries. This is a standalone OFAC SDN designation chart (not a typology-list document), so the single front-companies typology (SAN004) was supported at high confidence because the document develops the technique across eleven linked entities rather than a single passing mention. No transaction-level, narrative TBML, correspondent-banking or capital-markets content is present in this document.
